nom: Black Girl Sunscreen Make It Hybrid Broad Spectrum SPF 50

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are mostly positive about irritation, several reporting no itchiness or burning even on very reactive skin and one specifically calling out no facial breakouts; the exception is one reviewer with very sensitive skin whose face broke out, though the same product worked fine on her daughter's skin.
segments.dry: The one reviewer who names normal-to-dry skin found the sunscreen pilled on top of every moisturizer she tried and left a milky residue, calling it unusable in her routine.

concerns.dehydration: The reviewers who mention hydration say the sunscreen moisturizes their skin well, and a couple specifically note it prevented the dryness or peeling they usually get after sun exposure.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers report an adverse reaction to the reformulated version, including one who developed a rash and skin burn and another whose face burned after applying it; most other reviewers report no irritation at all.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers credit consistent use with improving uneven skin tone and fading dark spots, including one who started using it on her esthetician's advice for uneven tone.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers are split on breakouts: several report clogged pores, mild breakouts, or pimples forming as the product turns oily on their skin, while others, including one who compared it favorably to sunscreens that did break her out, report no breakouts at all.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers describe the finish as light and non-greasy once absorbed, though a few warn it can turn oily or heavy if too much product is applied, and one reviewer says it became noticeably oily and triggered pimples within minutes of application.

aspects.libelle: Cast complaints common but inconsistent between users
Blends in well once fully rubbed in
Some prefer it for body rather than face

extraits.texte: The formula has definitely changed for the worst. In the past I would highly recommend but this new "mineral" change is horrible and caused a rash and skin burn. Also very watery. Will no longer be using or buying this product.
This product is so oily. Its starts off matte and afrer 5 minutes literally it gets sooo oily. Then you feel the pimples forming. I wanted to love it but no, do not purchase it.

It broke me out. I have very sensitive skin. I've been looking for a sunscreen that would agre with my skin, but this didn't. I use it on my daughter now during her track meets to shield from the sun but as for me and my sensitive skin… it's a no. So far it's agreed with my daughter's skin. I use it on her face, neck, arms and legs.

I have sensitive facial skin and this does not break me out. There is not white cast for me. I do notice a little in the beginning, but as I continue to massage into my skin it goes away like poof. I have tried so many sunscreens and this by far is better for my melanin skin. I have been using for a few years and I am satisfied. It is moisturizing and I use under my makeup. Not everyone's skin is the same, results will vary.

I absolutely love this product! It is the last item i use in my daily skin routine die the morning! The ONLY time ive had a white cast on my brown skin is when i didnt allow the other products to dry prior to application. My esthetician advised me start usng sunscreen bc of my uneven skin tone.. I've noticed a huge differnce and i ALWAYS wear my big sunglasses to protect my eyes from dark spots

Clears my skin, and dark spots every time. Also, don't put more than a dime sized amount in! A little of this product goes a long way, it'll feel greasy if you put more than needed, and will be harder to rub on.
I have a sun allergy and I apply this several times during the day has lessened my reaction. I also like that it's kind of moisturizing.
